newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* Ringgit continues to decline in the morning, dipping to 2.78 a dollar against 2.77 on Tuesday. Seen heading towards 2.80, its all-time historical low.
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell by a further 101 points to three-week low of 7,961 on new evidence that U.S. economic growth is slowing.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index came close to its four-year low, before ending down 4.89 points to 897.25.
* "There is strong resistance at around 880-885, we could see a rebound from there," said an independent dealer with a local brokerage.
* But some broking dealers said cash calls on leveraged investors and continued uncertainty over the ringgit could see continued selling.
* Focus on debut of Ocean Capital, after PPB Oil Palms on Tuesday managed just an eight cents premium.
